Panel Tags of the Composite Figures of PhyloCactus

Source: R/palette.R
phylocactus_panel_tags.Rd

Every composite figure of the package and of the tutorial scripts takes its panel tags from this function, so that their style is changed in one place when a journal asks for it: A, B by default; options(phylocactus.tag_suffix = ")") gives A), B), and options(phylocactus.tag_levels = "a") gives lower-case letters.

Usage

phylocactus_panel_tags(...)

Arguments

...

Further arguments of patchwork::plot_annotation() (a caption, a theme).

Value

A patchwork annotation to add to a composite figure.

See also

theme_phylocactus().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
patchwork::wrap_plots(p1, p2) + phylocactus_panel_tags()
options(phylocactus.tag_suffix = ")")
} # }
